Public Health Engineering Dept, Odisha 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Odisha · IN 
 
 No. CC/57/2011/122 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "Six-Lane Highway - Odisha Pkg-122" (expressways), awarded
 to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
 completed in all respects on 12/06/2011 at a gross executed value of Rs. 4000.00 Lakh (Rupees
 40.00 Crore Only). 
 
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
 satisfactory completion of the final inspection. 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Imran Joshi. This certificate is issued for record
 and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
 performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Public Health Engineering Dept, Odisha
